2607.27578.title: What makes prompts a graph: necessary and sufficient conditions for prompt graph engineering
2607.27578.paper_summary: Prompts stopped being isolated strings some time ago. In real systems, one model call feeds another, retrieval interleaves with generation, routers branch, and aggregators merge parallel results. Practice converged on a single structure to hold this together: the graph. Frameworks such as LangGraph, DSPy, and Prompt Flow expose it openly, and research systems already optimize it automatically. The vocabulary, however, lags behind. Graph names, variously, a reasoning topology inside one sampling strategy, a multi-agent conversation, or an orchestration artifact, while prompt engineering still evokes writing one good string. What is missing is a reference definition treating prompts as nodes of an explicit, executable, improvable graph. We build that definition through conceptual analysis over sources with persistent identifiers, complemented by primary grey literature. We reconstruct the genealogy of the idea, from dataflow graphs and build systems, through prompt chaining and the thought topologies (chain, tree, graph), to graphs compiled and optimized as artifacts. We then propose a constitutive definition of prompt graph engineering, state its four conditions (explicit structure, separation between structure and prompt content, executable semantics, and the graph as a first-class engineering artifact), and operationalize them as an inclusion and exclusion test. We draw the boundary against six neighboring concepts and apply the test to six real systems (LangGraph, DSPy, Prompt Flow, AutoGen, CrewAI, and Claude Code subagents); it includes and excludes consistently. We close with a research agenda organized along four design tension axes. The contribution is an operational definition and a shared vocabulary for a practice that industry already exercises daily without naming precisely.
2607.27578.paper_summary_zh: 提示在一段時間前就不再是孤立的字串了。<lb/>在實際系統中，一個模型的調用會影響另一個，檢索與生成交錯，路由器分支，聚合器合併平行結果。<lb/>實踐已經收斂到一個單一的結構來將這一切聯繫在一起：圖。<lb/>像 LangGraph、DSPy 和 Prompt Flow 這樣的框架公開展示了它，而研究系統已經自動優化了它。<lb/>然而，詞彙仍然滯後。<lb/>圖的名稱各不相同，可能是某一採樣策略內的推理拓撲、多代理對話或編排工件，而提示工程仍然讓人聯想到寫出一個好的字串。<lb/>缺少的是一個參考定義，將提示視為一個明確、可執行、可改進的圖的節點。<lb/>我們通過對具有持久標識符的來源進行概念分析來建立這一定義，並輔以初級灰色文獻。<lb/>我們重建這一思想的系譜，從數據流圖和構建系統，到提示鏈接和思維拓撲（鏈、樹、圖），再到作為工件編譯和優化的圖。<lb/>然後，我們提出提示圖工程的構成定義，陳述其四個條件（明確結構、結構與提示內容的分離、可執行語義，以及圖作為一級工程工件），並將其操作化為包含和排除測試。<lb/>我們與六個相鄰概念劃定邊界，並將測試應用於六個實際系統（LangGraph、DSPy、Prompt Flow、AutoGen、CrewAI 和 Claude Code 子代理）；它始終保持一致的包含和排除。<lb/>最後，我們提出了一個沿著四個設計張力軸組織的研究議程。<lb/>這一貢獻是一個操作性定義和一個共享詞彙，為業界每天都在實踐但未精確命名的活動提供支持。
